question: Seven boxes, D, E, F, G, S, T and U, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. No box is kept above F. Only three boxes are kept between F and S. Only one box is kept between D and E. E is kept immediately above S. Only four boxes are kept between D and G. T is kept at some place above U. Which box is kept second below T?
solution:
